description: Bounded public disposition for the 2026-09-18 Flash-Next representation panels: base codec comparison (raw ternary T1, LS-reencoded T1, Q2_0 donor, T1 plus dense ternary T2), an equal-added-byte correction panel over the donor and T1 bases, and a Q8_0 residual island on layer 0 / expert 283. Sanitized values are published; weights, container bytes, panel scripts, and captured activations are excluded.
model_name: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next expert weights, BF16 authority and Q2_0 donor scaffold
model_revision: public model card revision; the BF16 source tree and quantized container are excluded from publication
model_download_source: public model card exists but no weight payload, activation capture, or container byte is part of this repository
quant_name: ternary T1 (PTQ1_0-style, absmax group-128), LS-reencoded T1, Q2_0 donor scaffold, dense ternary T2 plane, Q8_0 residual island
quant_format_version: panel-local codec definitions recorded in the sanitized receipt
hardware_phenotype: measurement was tensor- and activation-level on the reference workstation; captions are in the sanitized receipt
kernel: not applicable; the panels are CPU tensor/activation comparisons
rust: not applicable; the panel scripts are excluded from publication
compiler: not applicable; the panel scripts are excluded from publication
prompt: not applicable; inputs are captured routed-MoE activations rather than prompts
context_size: 2048-token calibration pass and a 512-token holdout pass for activation capture
raw_output_digest: raw panel receipts excluded; sanitized values and metric definitions are recorded in sanitized_receipt.json

tolerance.equal_byte_constraint: verified in-panel; maximum deviation 0.005580357142857143 of budget against a 0.01 tolerance
tolerance.weight_rel_rms: mean-of-squares relative RMS against the BF16 authority tensor
tolerance.activation_error: Frobenius relative output error on captured activations

known_limitations: Fidelity is not capability: teacher-KL for these candidates is blocked and no end-to-end quality result exists.
The dense T1+T2 weight relRMS value is a per-slice measurement; the panel stores no mean weight relRMS per candidate.
The Q8_0 residual island is off-budget, costing about 4.86x the equal-byte budget used by the correction panel.
The donor row describes the real container bytes; a same-rate re-encode of the same BF16 source measures far worse and must not be conflated with it.
One earlier receipt recorded a per-role T1 payload 4x too large; the corrected value is used here and the defect is recorded.
The BF16 source, container bytes, panel scripts, and captured activations are excluded, so this lane is not a runnable public benchmark.
